record.paper_title: Open problems from the 12th International Conference on Fuzzy Set Theory and Its Applications
record.original_question: Within a chosen class of fuzzy implications on [0,1]^2, such as (S,N)-implications, R-implications, f-implications, or g-implications, characterize exactly those implications I for which the exchange principle I(x, I(y, z)) = I(y, I(x, z)) is preserved under the lattice operations of pointwise minimum and pointwise maximum. Equivalently, determine which subfamilies remain closed under forming I \/ J and I /\ J while still satisfying the exchange principle.

evidence.quote: Problem 3.1 (M. Baczynski, B. Jayaram). Characterize the subfamily of all fuzzy implications ((S,N)-implications, R-implications, etc.) which preserve the (EP) for lattice operations.

artifact.status_search_result: The problem has received substantial attention but remains only partially resolved. Vemuri and Jayaram (2020) gave sufficient conditions for preservation of (EP) under join and meet specifically for $(S,N)$-implications, and there is an EUSFLAT 2011 / Atlantis Press contribution providing a complete characterization for $R$-implications regarding the exchange principle. No source provides a complete characterization for all the listed families ($f$-implications, $g$-implications, etc.).

status_evidence.title: Preservation of the Exchange Principle via Lattice Operations on (S,N)-Implications
status_evidence.snippet: Presents sufficient conditions such that the exchange principle is preserved under join and meet operations on (S,N)-implications.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results known for the (S,N)-implications subfamily.

status_evidence.title: R-implications and the Exchange Principle: A Complete Characterization
status_evidence.snippet: A complete characterization for R-implications and the exchange principle.
status_evidence.claim: The R-implication subcase has been characterized.

status_evidence.title: Fuzzy Implications: Some Recently Solved Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of recently solved problems on fuzzy implications by Baczynski and Jayaram.
status_evidence.claim: Survey documents progress; full characterization across all listed families not reported.
